note: The outreach pushback on installers (the rustup debate, getplumber/plumber#390): the rustup project's own installer piped into sh, in a test job with contents: read and no secret. The installer can change without a change in this repository, but whoever controls it reaches a job that holds nothing and saves no cache: code execution alone on an ephemeral runner, Low. The debian:forky-slim container is a mutable image into the same job, Low as well. Hand count: two Low paths 2 x 3 = 6, no other finding, so 100 - 6 = 94: A.
